### But Lord, I Don’t Want to Go There
Author: Arlene Pellicane
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement/encouragement-for-today-december-23-2016.html
Passage: Matthew 2:13-14
Points:
- Following seasons of celebration and comfort, God may call us to leave what is familiar.
- Joseph and Mary obeyed immediately when told to flee to Egypt, despite its history of tyranny and danger.
- Mary demonstrated humble trust in God’s guidance without arguing, delaying, or demanding her own way.
- Stepping into unfamiliar places in obedience allows God to fulfill His greater purposes in and through us.

### God's Son Is Called
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/gods-son-called
Passage: Matthew 2:15
Points:
- God originally delivered Israel from Egypt so they would shine as a light to all nations.
- When ancient Israel failed in its calling, God sent Jesus as the obedient, true Israel.
- Jesus' journey into and out of Egypt fulfilled prophecy and advanced God's redemption for the whole world.
- Believers delivered from the power of sin should respond to this grace by pursuing lives of holiness.
